baseline: width 1; beta .4; eta 0; M0 identity or M1 identity knots; M2 correction0; rho0
otherStarts: 15 uniform over the full bounded optimization coordinate box
monotoneMap: sort eight [0,255] optimization coordinates, keeping all eight

hardRails.method: LS seed then SLSQP constrained LS

minimax.method: independent-original-start SLSQP epigraph of bin/channel mean absolute pixel error
minimax.refinement: each LS result seeds a second SLSQP epigraph solve at the same maxiter/ftol; retain raw and refined results; choose only forward-feasible converged candidates
minimax.zeroFloorBracket: a forward-feasible upper <=1e-8 codes may be selected with the exact objective floor0; optimizerSuccess/converged remain unchanged, never relabelled; report bracket separately

rank: finite difference of raw uncensored predictions; all singular values; width quadrature plateaus not regularized
mass: equal cell, equal measured bin/channel group within cell, equal uncensored pixel within group; rail constraints hard
authority: LOCAL; optimizer failure or rail/epigraph failure is not a family negative
scope: array API only; caller admits calibration roles/populations and holds shadow; no archive reader
amendment: Synthetic raw-start SLSQP reached a line-search failure at0.0005319 codes on a planted near-exact fit; preserve it beside declared LS-seeded refinement, before any native fit.
